parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3338195 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL395 (HepG2). Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL3338195 to include all child salts. Retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target CHEMBL395. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows; preserve all activity records. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
